sloka: शिरसा त्वा ऽभियाचे ऽहं कुरुष्व करुणां मयि ।बान्धवेषु च सर्वेषु भूतेष्विव महेश्वर: ॥ २.१०६.३१॥
transliteration: śirasā tvā 'bhiyāce 'haṁ kuruṣva karuṇāṁ mayi ।bāndhaveṣu ca sarveṣu bhūteṣviva maheśvara: ॥ 2.106.31॥

translations.english: I beseech you with my head bowed low, show mercy on me and every one of our relations, like Maheswara showing compassion on all living beings.
